description: lululemon athletica inc. is principally a designer, distributor and retailer of technical athletic apparel, footwear and accessories, with a vision to create transformative products and experiences that build meaningful connections, unlocking greater possibility and wellbeing for all, and a purpose to elevate human potential by helping people feel their best. Since its inception it has fostered a distinctive corporate culture built on core values that include taking personal responsibility, acting with courage, valuing connection and inclusion, and choosing to have fun, and its core business is a women's range, with men's a key pillar of strategic growth and accessories an area of continued innovation and expansion. In this Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended February 1, 2026 it refers to that year as 2025 and the fiscal year ended February 2, 2025 as 2024.
